natural_language_statement: For real a > 0 and any real b, the natural floor ⌊a x + b⌋₊ tends to infinity as x tends to infinity, and its real cast divided by x tends to a. If f n / n^d tends to L, then f ⌊a x + b⌋₊ / x^d tends to L a^d.
explanation: The first two limits establish the growth and scale of the affine natural-floor index. Composing the assumed normalized limit with this index and multiplying by the d-th power of the floor-to-x ratio yields the stated rescaling law.
